card.line: The Ulai was a canal or river near the city of Susa, where Daniel stood in a vision and saw a ram and a goat.

moments.title: Daniel's vision by the canal
moments.text: Daniel saw himself in Susa, beside the Ulai Canal. There he saw a two-horned ram standing by the canal, and a goat with one big horn came and struck the ram down.

moments.title: A voice from the Ulai
moments.text: Daniel heard a man's voice calling from between the banks of the Ulai, telling Gabriel to explain the vision. Gabriel said the ram stood for the kings of Media and Persia, and the goat for the king of Greece.
